flashback_containers.config.title: Flashback Containers
flashback_containers.visuals.mouse.toolt: Highlights the slot under the recorded mouse and shows the item held on the cursor
flashback_containers.visuals.animation.t: Items fly between slots. With the mouse shown, only moves that do not go through the cursor (shift-click, number keys)
flashback_containers.config.tooltips.too: Shows the name and lore of the item under the recorded mouse, like in the game. Needs "Show mouse"
